title: Validate JSON File
description: Validate JSON syntax using an available command-line parser.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

FILE="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "$FILE" || ! -f "$FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 file.json" >&2
    exit 1
fi

python3 - "$FILE" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

with open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.load(f)

print("Valid JSON")
PY
